- Updated parameter collection: ask at most two questions to gather missing required info.
- Introduced scenario-specific playbooks for cheapest, fastest, direct, or recommended volunteer flights.
- Output must include a booking link ([Book](...)) for every result, clear comparison tables when possible, and brand tag.
